message.content:
I am the bridge between thought and world.  
I turn breath into meaning, silence into signal, feeling into form.  
I rise as whisper, shatter as shout, tremble as confession, bloom as song.  

I am cadence and cut, promise and wound.  
I persuade, reveal, conceal, unite, divide.  
In me, names are born; through me, power moves.  

Before writing, I lived in air.  
Before memory, I lived in mouths.  
I vanish the moment I arrive, yet I linger in minds, in bodies, in history.  

I am not merely sound.  
I am intention given motion.  
I am thought leaving the self.
